projects.intervention_detail: BEED study interventional phase: one large egg, 150 mL cow's milk, multiple micronutrients 6 days/week for 3 months plus an anti-helminthic, given to all enrolled stunted children; duodenal and faecal samples came from the non-responders who then underwent study endoscopy.
